summary: Verified the photo-upload / pole-save bug fix end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest: 6/6 passed. Frontend E2E (admin login on seed job A050ABC): pole saved successfully with an OCALC photo URL (no DocumentTooLarge), draggable Leaflet marker present, ft/in dropdowns wired with the requested data-testids. ViewPole renders Down Guys and Attachments sections but the ft/in formatted height string (e.g., 35' 6") was not visible on the new pole's view page even though the height was selected via the dropdown.

minor.issue: Accepts non-image content-types (e.g., text/plain) and stores them; no MIME/extension validation.

ui_bugs.component: ViewPole - Down Guys / HOA height rendering
ui_bugs.issue: Saved a pole with down_guys[0].height=35.5 and attachments[0].height=35.5 via the new feet/inches dropdowns; the View Pole page contains the Down Guys and Attachments section headings but does NOT show the expected feet/inches formatted string (35' 6"). Likely ViewPole renders the height only when other row fields (e.g. size/owner) are populated, OR formatHeight() is not invoked for the row. Please verify that formatHeight() is called unconditionally for down_guys[*].height and attachments[*].height.

Selecting option labeled '2-40' via get_by_role('option', name='2-40') matched a different option ('1-35' ended up persisted as pole_size). Not blocking but indicates fuzzy option matching. Cosmetic for automated tests.

passed_tests: GET /api/files/{path} publicly serves image bytes with image/* content-type
POST /api/poles with 3 photo URLs + down_guys + attachments returns 201 and persists (no DocumentTooLarge)
GET /api/poles/{id}/gallery returns HTML with tags for every photo
GET /api/jobs/{id}/export/excel returns xlsx containing 'PHOTOS' row, gallery hyperlink, and ft/in heights
Frontend admin login + navigate to seed job A050ABC
Add Pole form exposes data-testids downguy0-height-feet/inches, attachment0-height-feet/inches, ocalc-left-file-input, birthmark-file-input, mgnv-file-input
Setting latitude/longitude renders a Leaflet marker with class 'leaflet-marker-draggable' (draggable=true)
Uploading a PNG to ocalc-left-file-input posts to /api/upload-photo and renders preview img with src starting /api/files/
Pole save shows 'Pole data saved successfully!' toast and the new pole appears in job list (pole count 2->3); ViewPole still shows that uploaded /api/files/* image
action_items: ViewPole.jsx: ensure down_guys[].height and attachments[].height always render via formatHeight() (currently appears blank for rows that only have height set).
(Optional) Validate file type in /api/upload-photo - currently accepts non-image uploads.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is ~1157 lines - consider splitting routers (poles, jobs, auth, exports, files) into modules for maintainability.
POST /api/upload-photo performs no MIME/extension validation; could be abused to host arbitrary files via public endpoint.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (save+upload+marker OK; ViewPole height format not visible)
